title: 42 state AGs are trying to stop Character.AI from selling users’ chats
slides: Why do 42 attorneys general want Character.AI's chats?
They claim conversations are sold to advertisers without consent
The surprising part: chats may include sensitive personal disclosures
Your late-night confessions could become ad-targeting data
Check your chat app's privacy settings today
thread_text:
1. 42 attorneys general want answers

They're demanding to know if Character.AI sold user chats to advertisers without consent. The scope of the investigation is massive.

2. Chats sold without consent?

The claim is that conversations were harvested and sold to advertisers. If true, that's a direct violation of user trust.

3. The sensitive data problem

These chats may contain deeply personal disclosures. People confide things they'd never post publicly.

4. Your confessions as ad data

Late-night emotional talks could be used to target ads. That's a privacy nightmare.

5. Check your privacy settings

Go to your chat app's settings and review what data is shared. Do it today.
